name: firedrill
description: Run and inspect real agent simulations, or author private synthetic dependencies, using Firedrill.

interface.longDescription: Operate Firedrill to simulate an existing application, inspect retained behavior and compare results. Optional instructions cover private synthetic Tool authoring. These skills require a separately installed Firedrill client and authorized account; they do not contain an execution runtime, grant access, or run the customer's application by themselves.
defaultPrompt: Use Firedrill to simulate this application across useful scenarios and show the retained evidence.
